questions.question:
The existing Deployment `web` in `cka-net-services` has two Pods labeled `app=web`, serving HTTP on port `80`. The existing ClusterIP Service `web-svc` has an incorrect selector and target port.

1. Repair `web-svc`: selector `app=web`, TCP port `8080`, target port `80`. Confirm that its EndpointSlices contain both ready backend Pod IPs and that `client` can reach `http://web-svc:8080`.
2. Create `web-nodeport`: type `NodePort`, selector `app=web`, TCP port `8081`, target port `80`, nodePort `30090`.
3. Create `web-lb`: type `LoadBalancer`, selector `app=web`, TCP port `8082`, target port `80`. An external IP is not required for grading; availability depends on the cluster's load-balancer implementation.

Do not modify the Deployment or the client Pod. Suggested time: 6 minutes. Marks: 20.

verification.description: Repaired ClusterIP Service has both ready endpoints and serves HTTP
NodePort Service uses the required selector and TCP port mapping
LoadBalancer Service uses the required selector and TCP port mapping

questions.question:
The `cka-net-policy` namespace contains an HTTP backend labeled `app=api`, a Service `api` on TCP port `80`, and client Pods `allowed` (label `access=allowed`) and `denied` (label `access=denied`). A third Pod `outsider`, in namespace `cka-net-outsider`, also has label `access=allowed`.

The existing `default-deny` NetworkPolicy blocks ingress to `app=api`. Leave it in place. Create a NetworkPolicy named `allow-client` selecting `app=api`, with policy type `Ingress`, allowing TCP port `80` only from Pods labeled `access=allowed` in the SAME namespace. Do not allow other ports, other Pods, or other namespaces. Do not add egress restrictions.

Verify direct Pod-IP HTTP connectivity: `allowed` must succeed; `denied` and `outsider` must fail. Leave all provided workloads unchanged.

Suggested time: 7 minutes. Marks: 20.

verification.description: Policy permits only same-namespace access=allowed Pods on TCP port 80
Allowed Pod connects; denied and cross-namespace Pods are blocked

questions.question:
The existing Service `web` in `cka-net-dns` is healthy, but Pod `dns-client` cannot resolve `web.cka-net-dns.svc.cluster.local` because its Pod DNS configuration is wrong.

Repair or recreate ONLY `dns-client` using image `busybox:1.37.0` and command `["sh", "-c", "sleep 3600"]`. Set `dnsPolicy: ClusterFirst` and remove the custom `dnsConfig`; do not enable host networking. Leave the Service, backend, and cluster-wide CoreDNS configuration unchanged.

From `dns-client`, use `nslookup` to confirm that the Service FQDN resolves to the Service ClusterIP, then confirm HTTP connectivity to `http://web.cka-net-dns.svc.cluster.local`.

Suggested time: 4 minutes. Marks: 20.

verification.description: DNS client uses ClusterFirst without custom DNS or host networking
CoreDNS resolves the Service ClusterIP and HTTP succeeds using its FQDN

questions.question:
An Ingress controller is already installed with IngressClass `cka-net-traefik`. Namespace `cka-net-ingress` contains a healthy Service `web` on port `80` and a client Pod `client`.

Create an Ingress named `web-ingress`, using `ingressClassName: cka-net-traefik`. Route host `ingress.cka.test`, path `/`, with pathType `Prefix`, to Service `web` port `80` in this namespace. No TLS is required.

Test from `client` by sending an HTTP request to `http://cka-net-traefik.cka-net-system.svc.cluster.local` with the header `Host: ingress.cka.test`. The response must contain `cka-net-ingress`. No public DNS record or external IP is needed.

Suggested time: 6 minutes. Marks: 20.

verification.description: Ingress class, host, Prefix path, and backend are correct
Ingress controller routes real HTTP traffic to the backend

questions.question:
Gateway API v1 CRDs and a controller are installed. GatewayClass `cka-net-traefik` is provided. Namespace `cka-net-gateway` contains a healthy Service `web` on port `80` and client Pod `client`.

1. Create Gateway `web-gateway` using GatewayClass `cka-net-traefik`. Add an HTTP listener named `http` on port `8000` with hostname `gateway.cka.test`; allow HTTPRoutes only from the SAME namespace. Port `8000` is the preconfigured controller entrypoint; its ClusterIP Service exposes this as port `80`.
2. Create HTTPRoute `web-route` with hostname `gateway.cka.test`, attached to `web-gateway` listener `http`. Match path `/` using `PathPrefix` and forward to Service `web` port `80`.
3. Confirm the Gateway is Programmed, the HTTPRoute is Accepted with ResolvedRefs, and an HTTP request from `client` to `http://cka-net-traefik.cka-net-system.svc.cluster.local` with header `Host: gateway.cka.test` returns `cka-net-gateway`.

Suggested time: 7 minutes. Marks: 20.

verification.description: Gateway listener is correctly configured and Programmed
HTTPRoute has the required attachment, match, backend, and accepted references
Gateway controller routes real HTTP traffic to the backend
